added.t: In May 2025, Berkshire's Board of Directors appointed Mr. Gregory E. Abel to succeed Mr. Warren E. Buffett as Chief Executive Officer effective January 1, 2026.
The U.S. freight transportation infrastructure is integrated.

removed.t: Major investment decisions and all major capital allocation decisions are made by Warren E. Buffett, Chairman of the Board of Directors and Chief Executive Officer, age 94.

changed.t: If for any reason the services of our key personnel were to become unavailable, there could be a material adverse effect on our operations.
